entries.75637ac6ed1ed55d: This business is entrusted by credit card companies and provides concierge services for cardholders, arranging restaurant reservations, event ticket acquisition and similar services. This service helps people enjoy life overseas more fully, in contrast to medical assistance that responds to emergencies such as illness or injury. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥484 million.
entries.918b7b0e3c94f2a0: This business coordinates medical care for people who fall ill or are injured while traveling or on business overseas, so that they can receive necessary treatment even in places with different languages and medical systems, from telephone support through arranging medical consultations to arranging hospitalization and transport (including repatriation). It consists of services attached to overseas travel insurance that are entrusted by non-life insurance companies, and services developed in-house under direct contracts with companies, universities and government agencies. Depending on the calling region and time of day, the company and six overseas centers receive calls, and the Tokyo head office provides advanced coordination, including for seriously ill patients, on a 24-hour basis. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥3,230 million, the largest in the group.
entries.92167c4b4c106789: In partnership with a risk management specialist company operating globally, it provides overseas residents and travelers with local security information and advice, and support for emergency evacuation when incidents occur. The amount is not separately disclosed.
entries.9d5de9d96119c62f: Offered under the name “OSSMA,” this is a service that provides medical support to students studying abroad, as well as search support when they cannot be contacted or are missing, and assistance in resolving everyday problems in overseas life, and is provided under contracts with universities. The amount is not separately disclosed.
entries.9f54c9b1485404a9: Medical support services related to government agency business
entries.c63450b32cf33374: Under the service terms of non-life insurance companies, a service that, when policyholders of overseas travel insurance are injured or fall ill outside their home country, provides support from telephone assistance through medical consultation arrangements to transport. It is entrusted by non-life insurance companies. The amount is not separately disclosed.
entries.ca167d2fe58f9a17: Companies and government agencies expanding overseas
entries.e1ad8c26b4566b6a: Under direct contracts with companies and government agencies expanding overseas, medical support and crisis management services are provided to overseas staff and travelers, including provision of local medical information, arrangement of vaccinations and health checks, and arrangement of medical consultations when they fall ill. The amount is not separately disclosed.
entries.e3cbe266aba2253c: A project-based service in which paramedics and nurses are stationed at local plants and remote sites to build a medical system and provide emergency response and daily health management; it is also offered to private companies as “EAJ Project Assist.” The amount is not separately disclosed.
